content.title: Oscars Winner 2026: Michael B Jordan's Breakup Reason With Ex-GF, Lori Harvey, 'Not Ready To Commit'
content.text: Actor, Michael B Jordan, is currently leading the headlines as he won the 2026 Oscar Award for Best Actor for his dual role in Sinners. The 98th edition of the Academy Awards was held on March 15, 2026, at Hollywood's Dolby Theatre, and was a star-studded affair. Michael's clenching of the prestigious award at the event is deemed iconic as he is only the sixth artist of colour to have ever reached the milestone. As he beat talented actors like Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio to win the title, the spotlight fell on his personal life, particularly his past relationship with Lori Harvey and the reason for their breakup. Who is Michael B Jordan's ex-girlfriend, Lori Harvey? Lori Harvey is an American model, entrepreneur, and socialite who is widely recognised as the adoptive daughter of comedian and television host, Steve Harvey. As of March 2026, she has established herself as a significant figure in the fashion and beauty industries through her own business ventures and a high-profile modelling career. Signed with IMG Models and WME, she has walked runways for Dolce & Gabbana and starred in campaigns for luxury brands like Burberry, Michael Kors, and Valentino. Lori also founded the skincare line SKN by LH in 2021 and the swimwear brand Yevrah Swim in 2023. In 2024, she made her acting debut in the Peacock limited series, Fight Night: The Million Dollar Heist. She frequently makes headlines for her relationships with high-profile celebrities. One of her most publicised romantic endeavours was with Sinners star, Michael B Jordan. About Michael B Jordan and Lori Harvey's relationship Michael B Jordan and Lori Harvey's dating rumours began in late 2020 after they were spotted together in her hometown of Atlanta during Thanksgiving. After months of speculation, the duo confirmed their relationship on Instagram, sharing couple photos in January 2021. The following month, Jordan rented out an entire aquarium for their first Valentine's Day. After staying lowkey for a while, Michael and Lori generated buzz in November 2021, when they celebrated their first anniversary with social media tributes. In March 2022, the pair made their red carpet debut at the Vanity Fair Oscars afterparty. Why did Michael B Jordan and Lori Harvey end their relationship? Continue reading below Michael and Lori were confirmed to have broken up on June 4, 2022, by a source close to the couple. The insider told Entertainment Tonight that their relationship ended after roughly a year and a half of dating because they were reportedly at different stages in their lives and had different expectations from their respective partner. Jordan, who was 35 at the time, had matured significantly and was reportedly ready to commit for the long term and settle down. The source stated that he "let down his guard" with Lori, which made his relationship with her different from those with his exes. Mentioning that Michael was more emotionally invested in the relationship, the insider stated: "Michael and Lori are both completely heartbroken. They still love each other. Michael matured a lot over the course of their relationship and was ready to commit for the long term. He let down his guard with her, opening up emotionally in a romantic relationship for the first time. They had great times together and brought out the best in each other." Another source echoed similar sentiments, telling PEOPLE about Lori Harvey's views on the relationship with Michael. On June 6, 2022, they stated that the former couple had divergent life goals. According to the source, Lori, who was 25 at the time, was not ready for the level of commitment Michael wanted from her. She didn't want to settle down yet and wanted to focus on her career and "have fun and be free." Reports indicated that when the duo began planning their future, they realised they were not on the same page. Although they were both heartbroken that the relationship had ended, the split was inevitable. The source was quoted as: "[Lori] wasn't ready to commit. She is very focused on her career. [She] realised that they weren't on the same page [while they] were making plans for their future. She still wants to have fun and be free. Michael is a great guy. She is sad that their relationship didn't work out, but she is moving on." What are your thoughts on Michael B Jordan and Lori Harvey's breakup reason? Let us know.
